runbooks.diagnosis: Paperless-Gotenberg OCR/conversion timeouts happen on large PDFs with the default timeout, or when the gotenberg container was recreated with a different hostname than PAPERLESS_URL expects.
remediation: Raise the gotenberg timeout in paperless config for large documents
Verify PAPERLESS_URL matches the gotenberg container's reachable address
Re-trigger consumption after fixing; the file stays in the consume dir

runbooks.diagnosis: Paperless task queue (celery) lost Redis: wrong PAPERLESS_REDIS URL or redis restarted with a flushed queue while consumers were mid-task.
remediation: Verify PAPERLESS_REDIS points at the compose redis service
Restart the paperless consumer/webserver pair after redis is healthy
